concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: Brahmo Samaj, the theistic movement within Hinduism, was founded by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in the year ______.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1828**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmo Samaj** was founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** in the year **1828**.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was a **reformist and theistic movement** within Hinduism, aiming to bring about **social, political, and religious changes**.
 
• It promoted the belief in a **formless, eternal, and omnipresent God** and rejected idol worship and meaningless rituals.
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, often regarded as the **Father of the Indian Renaissance**, was instrumental in initiating this reform movement to modernize Hindu society.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj played a significant role in the abolition of **social evils like Sati**, child marriage, and caste discrimination.
 
• It emphasized the importance of **education**, particularly for women, and encouraged **scientific inquiry** and rational thinking.
 
• The movement also advocated for **monotheism**, equality, and the elimination of superstitions in Indian society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1839**__

 __
 
• This year does not relate to the foundation of the Brahmo Samaj. However, it was a period marked by significant reformist activities in India.
 
 
 
• **1856**__
 __
 
• In this year, the **Widow Remarriage Act** was passed under the guidance of **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar**, another prominent social reformer.
 
 
 
• **1879**__
 
 
• No significant event related to the Brahmo Samaj occurred in this year. However, by this time, the Brahmo Samaj had split into two factions: **Adi Brahmo Samaj** and **Sadharan Brahmo Samaj**.
